entries.title: Panels that fail to load offer Try again
entries.body: If a panel such as Ideas, Quotes, Timeline or Glossary could not load its saved result, the only way back was to leave the mode and return. These panels now have a Try again button, and failure messages say what went wrong instead of showing the browser's error text. Thread no longer stays on loading when a retry fails.

entries.title: Regenerate waits until the new result has loaded
entries.body: After you asked for a fresh version in Summary's plain-words view, Ideas, Glossary, Thread, Sketch or Quiz, the old result stayed on screen with Regenerate still available, inviting a second paid run for the same thing. Regenerate is now held until the new result has loaded, and the panel offers to try loading it again while you wait.

entries.title: Link summaries follow your profile and purpose
entries.body: The summary on a link's hover card is written with your profile and reading purpose in mind. After you changed either, a card could go on showing a summary written for the old one. Those summaries are now cleared when you change your profile or purpose.

entries.title: Tap-to-talk no longer loses a reply
entries.body: When talking to an article out loud in tap-to-talk, a request refused at the wrong moment after you pressed Done could mean no reply was asked for, or leave the Talk button out of step with the call. These cases are handled, so the reply is still requested.

entries.title: Quiz keeps feedback when marking is interrupted
entries.body: If marking stalled or failed partway, the Quiz threw away the feedback that had already arrived. It now keeps what it received and leaves the question unanswered so you can try again. A raw technical error that could appear during marking is gone too. The Quiz is part of Remember, behind the Experimental features switch.

entries.title: Referee checks no longer hang or fail early
entries.body: In Referee, the check of the source document for hidden instructions could stay on "checking" forever; it now stops after a minute and asks you to reload. Claims and Criteria runs are no longer marked failed while still finishing, and both share one clearer message when an answer cannot be used. Referee needs the Experimental features switch.

entries.title: The Sketch shows its personalisation badge again
entries.body: The personalisation badge on Diagram's Sketch view was not appearing, which left the Sketch's Regenerate control out of reach. Both are back. Diagram is behind the Experimental features switch on your profile page.

entries.title: Illustrated says when the AI declined
entries.body: When the AI declined to write the brief for an Illustrated picture, you saw a general message that it could not be done for this article. It now tells you the AI declined. Illustrated is one of Diagram's pictures, behind the Experimental features switch.
